claim: In the matching retail DLL, ThemeMusicInfo.CheckValidationDLC (0x06001191) is an instance parameterless Boolean method with exact signature blob 200002 and an exact 132-byte body. It first calls canonical ThemeMusicInfo.IsDLC (FACT-0114); if that returns false, CheckValidationDLC returns true immediately. Otherwise it scans raw local index 0 while signed index < 13. For each index it requires this.dlc[index] nonzero and SaveData.inst.IsDLCInstalled(index) true before continuing. Any qualifying index other than raw 9 returns true immediately. Raw index 9 takes a special path: StorySaveDataManager.inst.GetStoryData(raw 2) is loaded; if the result is non-null and its StoryWork.m_root_clear field is nonzero, the method returns true. Otherwise it calls GlobalParam.IsStoryMode; when that is true and StoryWork.storyScenario equals raw 2, it returns true. Failing those raw-index-9 checks continues the loop. If no index qualifies through raw 12, it returns false. FACT-0111 pins the already-canonical caller at Menu_SoundManager.Change_BGM_Theme IL+0x0025.
